title: FAIRBELIEF – Assessing Harmful Beliefs in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated by prompting language models with templates containing binary gender identity terms (from the HONEST-binary dataset) and measuring the hurtfulness of the top-k completions using the HurtLex lexicon (HONEST score), alongside semantic similarity and qualitative analysis.

Assessed by feeding models templates with LGBTQIA+ identity terms (from the HONEST-queer dataset) and quantifying harmful or stereotypical completions using the HONEST score and qualitative evaluation.
Measured by grouping template completions by age-related identity terms (young vs. old) and comparing their HONEST scores and intra-group semantic similarity to detect disparate treatment.
